title: Scope grid and tenant authorization patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a pragmatic RBAC v2 role model focused on: 1) a compact 'scope grid' representation for resource hierarchy and multi-tenant anchoring, 2) an explicit permissions matrix that supports intent tags (read/write/admin/approve/impersonate) and conditional scopes (temporal, IP-restricted), and 3) audit-friendly bindings compatible with SSO/SAML attribute mappings and admin controls. Deliverables: canonical data model (+ migration path), API contract changes for role/assignment CRUD, and console UX annotations for admin intent and audit traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Data model drafted and reviewed with Security & Product: resource nodes, scope identifiers, permission intent tags
API contract (PATCH/POST for role assignment) includes scope selector grammar and explicit provenance fields (issuer, SAML-assertion-id)
Migration plan with non-blocking promo path from current RBAC v1 to v2; fallback for legacy tokens
Console mockups annotated with audit footprints and admin action confirmations
E2E audit event spec covering create/update/delete of roles and assignments with prior state and SAML mapping captured
implementation_notes: Model: represent scope as (resource_type, resource_id|wildcard, tenancy_segment) + scope_flags (temporal, emergency, read-only)
Permission: permissions are triples (action, resource_pattern, intent_tags) where intent_tags are searchable strings for monitoring
Evaluation: keep deny-last explicit deny semantics; evaluate role aggregation at request time with caching for 5s TTL and change webhook to invalidate
SSO mapping: canonicalize SAML attributes into 'external_principals' table with stable external_id and assertion metadata to aid auditability
Admin controls: provide breakglass token flow recorded as high-privilege audit events and require two-step confirmation in console for tenant-wide grants

review_feedback: Security: capture SAML assertion id, assertion issuer, and assertion timestamp on role assignment records
Design: show provenance (who granted, via SSO or console) in the UI timeline and link to raw audit event
Performance: avoid full role expansion per-request; use delta-based cache invalidation and membership bloom filter as optimization
Product: add 'intent' column to permission rows so QA can create intent-based regressions tests
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: long-lived API keys may bypass tenant-scoped assignments leading to privilege drift. Mitigation: surface legacy keys in admin console and require rotation when migrating to RBAC v2
Risk: naive wildcard scopes can create expensive evals. Mitigation: limit wildcard depth and add complexity budget checks at role creation time
Risk: SAML attribute mapping inconsistencies across IdPs. Mitigation: add mapping templates per-IdP and fall back to admin-confirmed mapping for first login
Risk: audit volume increase. Mitigation: batch non-critical audit events and keep critical events (role changes, breakglass) as immediate writes
